mods.name: RagnaCustomsApi
mods.author: Brollyy
mods.description: Reusable UE4SS Lua library for the RagnaCustoms catalog, downloads, and voting APIs.

releases.changelog: Requests now fail cleanly when the RagnaCustoms server is unavailable; mods using the API receive a clear error they can display or handle; and reliability is improved across supported UE4SS setups. No setup changes are required. Requires RagnaModManager >=1.1.0.

mods.name: RagnaCustomsVote
mods.author: Brollyy
mods.description: UE4SS Lua mod adding custom-song voting controls to Ragnarock Results screens.

releases.changelog: Vote for custom songs directly from the Results screen, see current vote totals and your selection, use the existing RagnaCustoms server configuration, and retry when voting is temporarily unavailable. Requires RagnaCustomsApi >=0.2.0 and a game CustomApiUrls entry for the RagnaCustoms WanApi endpoint.
